verified_facts.text: D-Resort Šibenik is located in the super-yacht marina D-Marin Mandalina and looks out over Šibenik Old Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the award-winning super-yacht marina D-Marin Mandalina, it offers an amazing view of the Šibenik Old Town

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed in a winding form to follow the shape of the Mandalina peninsula on which the resort sits.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel was designed in a winding form to  complement the shape of Mandalina peninsula, on which the resort is  situated.

verified_facts.text: The resort was designed by architect Nikola Bašić.
verified_facts.excerpt: With this concept, architect Nikola Bašić has managed to redefine the expected paradigm of luxury

verified_facts.text: The hotel is built of white concrete with inserts of wooden planks.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is built of white concrete with inserts of wooden planks, giving the building an impression of antiquity.

verified_facts.text: Each villa is different and asymmetric, and from the marina the villas seem to peek out of the rock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each villa is different, asymmetric, and when viewed from the marina, it seems they are peeking out of the rock.

verified_facts.text: In the rooms, wardrobes, commodes and nightstands are lifted off the floor so the furniture looks like it is floating.
verified_facts.excerpt: The idea was to make it look like the furniture is floating, which is why wardrobes, commodes, and nightstands in accommodation are lifted off the floor

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, a private balcony with marina views and an open-plan bathroom with a walk-in rainfall shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: This 33sq m intelligent room with floor-to-ceiling windows and a private balcony with views of the marina.    There’s a double bed and an open-plan bathroom with a walk-in rainfall shower.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private balcony with 180-degree views over the marina, the city and the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: a private balcony with 180-degree views that stretches over the marina, the city, and the sea.

verified_facts.text: The exclusive villas each have a private plunge pool with a wooden deck and views of the marina, plus private parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: private parking and a private plunge pool with wooden deck with views of the marina.

verified_facts.text: The villas include a kitchenette with an oven and dishwasher.
verified_facts.excerpt: as well as a kitchenette with an oven and dishwasher.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a heated infinity pool at the Yacht Club overlooking the marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: infinity heated swimming pool at Yacht Club overlooking the marina

verified_facts.text: There is a seaside swimming pool next to the Peninsula Grill & Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: the wonderful seaside swimming pool right next to the Peninsula Grill & Bar

verified_facts.text: There is a kids' pool equipped with swim vests and float noodles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your children will also have fun in the kid’s pool that is equipped with:       \- Swim Vests   \- Comfy Float-Fun Noodle

verified_facts.text: The resort has a rooftop running track and table tennis.
verified_facts.excerpt: you can enjoy our rooftop running track and table tennis in our facility

verified_facts.text: D-Spa uses Bernard Cassiere and Thalgo skincare products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our experts use only exclusive and unique skincare products, like Bernard Cassiere & Thalgo.

verified_facts.text: The spa centre is an adults' area; guests under 16 may use just the outdoor facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa center is adults only intended area, persons under the age of 16 are allowed to use only outdoor facilities.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers hammam rituals with a raw-silk glove scrub and a foam massage with argan oil and damask rose soaps.
verified_facts.excerpt: This ritual begins with a body scrub performed with a special glove made of raw silk, followed by a relaxing massage with a foam of carefully made soaps rich in argan oil and damask rose extract.

verified_facts.text: D-Gym has Technogym equipment and a group sunset yoga class three times a week.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is equipped with Technogym equipment. In addition to standard gym activities, you may as well join a group sunset yoga class 3 times a week

verified_facts.text: Motor yachts or sailing boats can be rented from the marina a few steps from the resort to explore the Šibenik Archipelago and Kornati National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The award-winning marina, located just a few steps away from D-Resort Šibenik, will offer you all the things you need to explore the hidden bays and beautiful islands of Šibenik Archipelago and Kornati National Park. If you wish, you can rent a motor yacht or sailing boat.

verified_facts.text: The resort is 30 minutes from some of Croatia's national parks and less than an hour's drive from Split and Zadar international airports.
verified_facts.excerpt: Only 30 minutes away from some of the most beautiful National Parks and less than an hour’s drive from Split's and Zadar's international airports

verified_facts.text: The Roof Bar by Moët & Chandon serves champagne and gourmet bites with views of Šibenik.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit the Roof Bar by Moët & Chandon over the weekend and experience its pleasant vibe and extravagant ambience while enjoying the magnificent view of Šibenik.

verified_facts.text: Peninsula Bar & Bistro sits in front of the hotel overlooking the Old Town, by a seaside pool surrounded by a large grassy area.
verified_facts.excerpt: The seaside swimming pool is surrounded by a large grassy area, making it ideal for relaxation.

verified_facts.text: In winter the hotel outlets close and just the Exclusive Sea View Villas can be reserved.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the winter period, only our Exclusive Sea View Villas are available for reservation.

verified_facts.text: The kids club is currently unavailable.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Kids club

verified_facts.text: The In-Formal Boutique at the resort sells nautical brands such as Henry Lloyd and Aqua of Croatia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nautical brands like Henry Lloyd and Aqua of Croatia will complement your shopping in the city of water sports.
